description: Java Spring Boot REST controller class defining CRUD endpoints for notes, including request handling, validation, and exception handling.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for notes, handling HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET /notes to list all notes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET /notes/{id} to retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST /notes to create a new note.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT /notes/{id} to update an existing note.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE /notes/{id} to delete a note.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions and returns error details.
